reason: The refrigerator needs a protective shell, and steel is a plausible material for its frame.
expectation: The steel will form a supporting case around the refrigeration insert.

alternatives.reason: A steel shell could instead be insulated before fitting the insert.

effect: The steel shell holds the refrigeration insert, leaving a gap for insulation and openings for heat rejection.
reaction: The separate compressor and radiator openings make the construction feel practical.
reason: The remaining insulation should fill the gap around the cold cradle.
expectation: The insulation will reduce heat flow into the refrigerated case.

effect: The refrigerator is insulated while its shock mounts and heat-rejection components remain functional; it is ready to mount.
reaction: Keeping the radiator exposed makes the insulation step feel physically sensible.
reason: The goal calls for mounting the completed field case on the rover.
expectation: The refrigerated case will be secured to the rover for the trip.

effect: The case is secured to the powered rover mount, completing the goal and leaving a cradle ready for the farther core.
reaction: The exposed radiator and empty cradle make the finished case feel practical and purposeful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the insulation while leaving the shock mounts and heat-rejection components clear was the most worthwhile step: it connected a simple combination to the physical needs of refrigeration and transport.

leastWorthwhile.text: Mounting the finished case was a predictable final step, though it provided a clear conclusion.

surprise.text: The shell had a gap around the cold cradle and separate openings for the compressor and radiator, making the design more considered than a simple protective box.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; each combination served the stated purpose of protecting and transporting the refrigerated core.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see the farther core collected and learn what it reveals; the practical case-building also made that next expedition feel grounded.
